### What It Is & Key Ingredients

Drinkwel combines standard daily vitamins and minerals with botanicals and amino acids aimed at liver support and recovery:[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14931813049035862953,catalogid:291939560758304200,gpcid:14133453692395667736,mid:576462896445003006&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXC6MezSIR6jTzHVI8CZVoMN1Cq08hXAe0aSnDO58rDoooD2mgKt3_0mxURGRPlRuMz9s2-bHhi8119EBMuHFLocnAVBJOU2OMke0uGwSqbmoQ1ytkM3s1sOSMFG_mYA0IH9UFgpd6nA)

- **Vitamins & Minerals:** Includes a full B-complex along with vitamins C and E, zinc, and magnesium to replenish depleted nutrients.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXBat4cxCfsNYrT-TjX93Yb6KaoE1MFdGzToyjVPqkNo-RDiCEExvYW8P_LgYYBT5UuUfIX3-gGMyblmtxEZcoDo5gleUtvOLEIKRsYreeJ1fWcL3XlnnvLzHNOQ)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14931813049035862953,catalogid:291939560758304200,gpcid:14133453692395667736,mid:576462896445003006&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXC6MezSIR6jTzHVI8CZVoMN1Cq08hXAe0aSnDO58rDoooD2mgKt3_0mxURGRPlRuMz9s2-bHhi8119EBMuHFLocnAVBJOU2OMke0uGwSqbmoQ1ytkM3s1sOSMFG_mYA0IH9UFgpd6nA)
- **Liver & Antioxidant Botanicals:** Features ingredients such as milk thistle, NAC (N-acetyl cysteine), artichoke extract, green tea extract, and adaptogens like reishi mushroom and rhodiola.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXHuFT7NgCkIbSViG7O8cruyPYujJ0iz7vCNkqqtLF1jBt7vdxBcDfBd7FELsafA_0r2XMR2ITvr0gqT6-8HSTO61y0DGj56yXLvA9w3MIMtdlb8Nr2SoiCV_5pg)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14931813049035862953,catalogid:291939560758304200,gpcid:14133453692395667736,mid:576462896445003006&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXC6MezSIR6jTzHVI8CZVoMN1Cq08hXAe0aSnDO58rDoooD2mgKt3_0mxURGRPlRuMz9s2-bHhi8119EBMuHFLocnAVBJOU2OMke0uGwSqbmoQ1ytkM3s1sOSMFG_mYA0IH9UFgpd6nA)

### Typical Usage

- **Social / Drinking Days:** Directions commonly advise taking **3 capsules** with food and water before drinking, and optionally **3 additional capsules** with water after the last drink or before bed.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14931813049035862953,catalogid:291939560758304200,gpcid:14133453692395667736,mid:576462896445003006&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXC6MezSIR6jTzHVI8CZVoMN1Cq08hXAe0aSnDO58rDoooD2mgKt3_0mxURGRPlRuMz9s2-bHhi8119EBMuHFLocnAVBJOU2OMke0uGwSqbmoQ1ytkM3s1sOSMFG_mYA0IH9UFgpd6nA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXXI2Qqx1e48Yl0PU9wEuK4lC8tLtXSh6JFNqTLiAqFt2anJpOj0bICape0ttPn1lyLx_gh_O4pGw0pXfyei2ZvY8Z1dRG_awD14rDquVre4wz4usVR-In-F_kgnUp1CBhIA)
- **Daily Use:** Can also be taken at **3 capsules daily** as a general multivitamin with added liver-support botanicals (check overlapping ingredients if taking other supplements).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14931813049035862953,catalogid:291939560758304200,gpcid:14133453692395667736,mid:576462896445003006&ibp=oshop)
